info.title: mdpkg
info.description: Package Markdown snapshots and curated Git history as .mdpkg archives with stable addressing, and validate their content and repository integrity.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Emits and checks conforming .mdpkg packages. Tool reference: docs/spec/generator-cli.md; format: docs/spec.md.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --format
options.description: json prints one result object on stdout, nothing else; diagnostics move to stderr (G-1). [default: text]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress progress on stderr; diagnostics are still emitted (G-1). [default: False]

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Lowercase UUID. Required for pack; other verbs take it from the input manifest, and a differing value is an error, never a rewrite (§4 namespace, §6.5 step 1).

options.name: --anchor
options.description: Anchor profile. The only value version 1 defines (§4, §6.2, C7). [default: cm0312-trail-source-v1]

options.name: --digest
options.description: Digest profile. The only value version 1 defines (§4, §6.1, C7). [default: cm0312-source-lf-v1]

options.name: --object-format
options.description: Git object format. sha256 is grammatical and unimplemented; it is rejected with MDPK4001 (D-14, §5.2, §11.2 item 1). [default: sha1]

options.name: --compression-level
options.description: DEFLATE level for working-tree entries. Producer policy only; readers accept any valid DEFLATE stream (§3.3). [default: 6]

options.name: --data-descriptors
options.description: Set GP bit 3 on every entry except the manifest. Off by default: descriptors cost 1,459 bytes on the measured npm package (§3.4, D-10). [default: False]

options.name: --reverse-index
options.description: Emit .rev. MAY be present, MUST NOT be required; the worked example omits it (D-8, C12). [default: False]

options.name: --strict-paths
options.description: Always on and cannot be disabled; the uniqueness and reservation rules are producer obligations (§3.6, D-11, D-16). [default: True]

options.name: --fail-on-warning
options.description: Promote every warn diagnostic to exit 3 (G-1). [default: False]

options.name: --report
options.description: Also write the result object to this file, even on a non-zero exit (§5.3, G-1).

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Emit a fresh package from a source directory (§7).

options.name: --out
options.description: Output package. Written to a temp sibling and renamed, so a failed run leaves no partial file (§2, §9).

options.name: --from-git
options.description: Import the source directory's own history instead of synthesising a single root commit (§5.3 sourceRepository, scope). [default: False]

options.name: --scope
options.description: Path projection recorded in history.json as scope; sets history.transform to ["projected"] (§4, §5.3, D-3).

options.name: --depth
options.description: Retain the last n first-parent commits. Sets history.coverage: truncated and root: synthetic (§4, §5.3, D-3).

options.name: --message
options.description: Commit message for the synthesised root (§5.1). [default: Initial package]

options.name: --require-complete
options.description: Exit 4 rather than write addressing.coverage: partial (§4, §6.3). [default: False]

options.name: --correspondence
options.description: Confirmed rename and lifecycle records (§7.1). Producer-confirmed only; a similarity score is never authority (§6.3).

arguments.name: SOURCE_DIR
arguments.description: Document tree that becomes the working tree of current. .git/ is ignored; a real .mdpkg/ outside .mdpkg/address/ is rejected with MDPK1002 (§3.6, §6.3).

commands.name: update
commands.description: Emit a new package from an existing one plus a new tree state or a history transform (§9). Always writes a new file.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output package. Written to a temp sibling and renamed, so a failed run leaves no partial file (§2, §9).

options.name: --tree
options.description: New working-tree state; becomes one commit on refs/heads/main (§5.1, §5.2). Required unless --squash is given alone.

options.name: --message
options.description: Commit message; required with --tree (§5.1).

options.name: --squash
options.description: Collapse a first-parent range into one emitted commit. Appends squashed to history.transform (§4, D-3).

options.name: --no-summary
options.description: Squash without a range summary. Every touched-since query over the collapsed range then answers unknown, never untouched (§5.4, §6.7). [default: False]

options.name: --truncate
options.description: Drop history before base. Sets history.coverage: truncated and root: synthetic; writes .git/shallow only for a genuine shallow clone (§5.3, D-3).

options.name: --retain-patches
options.description: Archive the exact patch bytes behind every hunk reference the producer has published (§5.5). [default: False]

options.name: --require-complete
options.description: Exit 4 rather than write addressing.coverage: partial (§4, §6.3). [default: False]

options.name: --correspondence
options.description: Confirmed rename and lifecycle records (§7.1). Producer-confirmed only; a similarity score is never authority (§6.3).

options.name: --accept-recoverable
options.description: Accept a tier 2 package and report tier: recoverable; it still fails conformance and SHOULD be re-emitted (§3.7). [default: False]

arguments.name: IN.MDPKG
arguments.description: Input package. Must type at offset 0 unless --accept-recoverable is given (§3.1, §3.7).

commands.name: address
commands.description: Record producer-confirmed addressing exceptions in the tracked ledger and commit the change (§10).

options.name: --out
options.description: Output package. Written to a temp sibling and renamed, so a failed run leaves no partial file (§2, §9).

options.name: --from-candidates
options.description: Load rename suggestions for review; none is written without an explicit --confirm <root> (§6.3, §9).

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Confirm one candidate from --from-candidates by its origin root. Repeatable (§6.3).

arguments.name: IN.MDPKG
arguments.description: Input package. Must type at offset 0 unless --accept-recoverable is given (§3.1, §3.7).

commands.name: move
commands.description: Record {"to": [scopeKind, path, trail]}: the reference resolves at the recorded locator; chains are flattened on update (§6.3, §6.5 step 2).

options.name: --root
options.description: Origin root of the entity, 64 lowercase hex digits; abbreviated hashes are never valid (§6.2, §10).

options.name: --to
options.description: Current locator: scopeKind:path:trail, for example "section:guide.md:# Guide/0,## Installation/0" (§6.3).

commands.name: retire
commands.description: Record {"dead": ..., "next": [...]}: flagged-changed with reason and successors, never a silent transfer (§6.3, §6.6).

options.name: --root
options.description: Origin root of the entity, 64 lowercase hex digits; abbreviated hashes are never valid (§6.2, §10).

options.name: --reason
options.description: Why the entity is dead (§6.3, §6.6).

options.name: --next
options.description: Successor locator. Repeatable (§6.3).

commands.name: unknown
commands.description: Record {"unknown": ...}: unconfirmed; the review is preserved externally and the badge is not moved (§6.3, §6.6).

options.name: --root
options.description: Origin root of the entity, 64 lowercase hex digits; abbreviated hashes are never valid (§6.2, §10).

options.name: --reason
options.description: Free text explaining why correspondence is unconfirmed (§6.3).

commands.name: mint
commands.description: Reserved-slot birth: mint a fresh random root plus {"to": <locator>} so the newcomer does not inherit a retired holder's root. Emits MDPK3002 (§6.3).

options.name: --locator
options.description: Locator of the newborn entity (§6.3).

commands.name: list
commands.description: Print the ledger. Writes no package, so --out is not required (§6.3).

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Run every §11 check against a package. Writes no package (§11).

options.name: --deep
options.description: Additionally read the pack: hash every current-view entry as a Git blob and compare with the tip tree; run git fsck --full --strict (§7.1, §11.2 item 13). [default: False]

options.name: --accept-recoverable
options.description: Accept a tier 2 package and report tier: recoverable; it still fails conformance and SHOULD be re-emitted (§3.7). [default: False]

arguments.name: IN.MDPKG
arguments.description: Input package. Must type at offset 0 unless --accept-recoverable is given (§3.1, §3.7).
